27.ar: يَا لَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ
27.en: "I wish it had been the end!"

28.ar: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ ۜ
28.en: "My wealth has not helped me at all!"

29.ar: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ
29.en: "My power has vanished from me!"

30.ar: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
30.en: "Seize him and shackle him!"

31.ar: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
31.en: "Then burn him in the Blaze!"

32.ar: ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ
32.en: "Then bind him in a chain seventy cubits long!"

33.ar: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
33.en: He never believed in God, the Great.

34.ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
34.en: And he never encouraged feeding the poor.

35.ar: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
35.en: So today he has no close friend here.

36.ar: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
36.en: And no food except festering pus.

37.ar: لَا يَأْكُلُهُ إِلَّا الْخَاطِئُونَ
37.en: None will eat it except the sinners.

38.ar: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
38.en: I swear by what you see.

39.ar: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
39.en: And what you do not see.

40.ar: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
40.en: This is the word of a noble messenger.

41.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ
41.en: It is not the word of a poet. How little you believe!

42.ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
42.en: Nor the word of a soothsayer. How little you reflect!

43.ar: تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
43.en: It is a revelation from the Lord of all worlds.

44.ar: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ
44.en: Had he fabricated any lies against Us.

45.ar: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ
45.en: We would have seized him by the right hand.

46.ar: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ
46.en: Then We would have severed his life-vein.

47.ar: فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
47.en: And none of you could have shielded him.

48.ar: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
48.en: This is a reminder for those who are mindful of God.

49.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنْكُمْ مُكَذِّبِينَ
49.en: We know that some among you will deny it.

50.ar: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
50.en: It will be a source of anguish for the disbelievers.

51.ar: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ
51.en: It is the absolute truth.

52.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ
52.en: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Great.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: A questioner asked about a punishment bound to fall.

2.en: Upon the disbelievers, none can repel it.

3.ar: مِنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ
3.en: From God, Lord of the pathways of ascent.

4.ar: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
4.en: The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a Day whose span is fifty thousand years.

5.ar: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
5.en: So be patient with graceful patience.

6.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا
6.en: They see it as distant.

7.ar: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا
7.en: But We see it as near.

8.ar: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ
8.en: The Day the sky will be like molten metal.

9.ar: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ
9.en: And the mountains will be like tufts of wool.

10.ar: وَلَا يَسْأَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
10.en: No close friend will ask about another close friend.

11.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ
11.en: They will be made to see each other. The criminal will wish he could ransom himself from that Day's punishment with his own children.

12.ar: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ
12.en: And his wife and his brother.

13.ar: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُؤْوِيهِ
13.en: And his clan that sheltered him.

14.ar: وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيهِ
14.en: And everyone on earth, if only it would save him.

15.ar: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
15.en: No! It is the Raging Blaze.

16.ar: نَزَّاعَةً لِلشَّوَىٰ
16.en: A stripper of scalps.

17.ar: تَدْعُو مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
17.en: It calls out to whoever turned away and fled.

18.ar: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰ
18.en: And gathered wealth and hoarded it.

19.ar: إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
19.en: The human being was created anxious.

20.ar: إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
20.en: When hardship touches him, he panics.

21.ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
21.en: And when good fortune touches him, he withholds.

22.ar: إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ
22.en: Except those who pray.

23.ar: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ
23.en: Those who are constant in their prayer.

24.ar: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَعْلُومٌ
24.en: And those in whose wealth there is a recognized share.

25.ar: لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ
25.en: For the beggar and the deprived.

26.ar: وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ
26.en: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment.

27.ar: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ
27.en: And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.

28.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
28.en: The punishment of their Lord is not something to feel safe from.

29.ar: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ
29.en: And those who guard their chastity.

30.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
30.en: Except with their spouses or those their right hands possess, for then they are not blamed.

31.ar: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ
31.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, those are the transgressors.

32.ar: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
32.en: And those who honor their trusts and their pledges.

33.ar: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ
33.en: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.

34.ar: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
34.en: And those who safeguard their prayer.

35.ar: أُولَٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُكْرَمُونَ
35.en: Those will be honored in gardens.

36.ar: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
36.en: So what is wrong with those who disbelieve, rushing toward you?

37.ar: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
37.en: From the right and from the left, in crowds.

38.ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
38.en: Does every one of them expect to enter a garden of bliss?

39.ar: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
39.en: No! We created them from what they know.

40.ar: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ
40.en: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests, We are certainly able.

41.ar: عَلَىٰ أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
41.en: To replace them with better than them, and We cannot be outdone.

42.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
42.en: So leave them to wade in falsehood and play until they meet their Day which they are promised.

43.ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
43.en: The Day they will emerge from the graves swiftly, as if racing toward an altar.

44.ar: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ
44.en: Their eyes downcast, humiliation covering them. That is the Day they were promised.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.ar: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
1.en: We sent Noah to his people: "Warn your people before a painful punishment comes upon them."

2.ar: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
2.en: He said, "O my people, I am a clear warner to you.

3.ar: أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
3.en: Worship God, be mindful of Him, and obey me.

4.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
4.en: He will forgive your sins and grant you respite until an appointed time. When God's appointed time arrives, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew.

5.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
5.en: He said, "My Lord, I have called my people night and day.

6.ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَائِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا
6.en: But my calling only increased their flight.

7.ar: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا
7.en: Every time I called them so You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, wrapped themselves in their garments, persisted, and grew arrogant with great arrogance.

8.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
8.en: Then I called them openly.

9.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
9.en: Then I proclaimed to them publicly and spoke to them privately.

10.ar: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
10.en: I said, "Seek forgiveness from your Lord. He has always been Most Forgiving.

11.ar: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا
11.en: He will send the sky upon you in abundant rain.

12.ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْهَارًا
12.en: He will provide you with wealth and children, and grant you gardens and rivers.

13.ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
13.en: What is wrong with you that you do not revere God's majesty?

14.ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
14.en: He created you in stages.

15.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا
15.en: Do you not see how God created seven heavens in layers?

16.ar: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
16.en: He placed the moon within them as a light and made the sun a lamp.

17.ar: وَاللَّهُ أَنْبَتَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
17.en: God grew you from the earth like plants.

18.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
18.en: Then He will return you to it and bring you forth again.

19.ar: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
19.en: God made the earth a spread for you.

20.ar: لِتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
20.en: So that you may travel through its wide paths.

21.ar: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَنْ لَمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
21.en: Noah said, "My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose wealth and children only increase them in loss.

22.ar: وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
22.en: They schemed a tremendous scheme.

23.ar: وَقَالُوا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
23.en: They said, "Never abandon your gods! Never abandon Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!"

24.ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا
24.en: They have led many astray. Increase the wrongdoers only in misguidance.

25.ar: مِمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنْصَارًا
25.en: Because of their sins, they were drowned and cast into the Fire. They found no helpers for themselves besides God.

26.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
26.en: Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave a single disbeliever dwelling on the earth.

27.ar: إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
27.en: If You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and breed nothing but wicked disbelievers.

28.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا
28.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and believing women. Increase the wrongdoers only in ruin.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.ar: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا
1.en: Say, "It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened and said, 'We have heard an amazing Quran.'

2.ar: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا
2.en: It guides to the right path, so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

3.ar: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
3.en: Exalted is the majesty of our Lord—He has taken neither a wife nor a son.

4.ar: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا
4.en: The foolish among us used to speak outrageous lies about God.

5.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ تَقُولَ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
5.en: We had thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about God.

6.ar: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
6.en: Some men among humans used to seek refuge with some men among the jinn, but they only increased them in burden.

7.ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا
7.en: They assumed, as you assumed, that God would never raise anyone.

8.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
8.en: We reached out to the sky and found it filled with fierce guards and flaming projectiles.

9.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَنْ يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَصَدًا
9.en: We used to sit in positions there to listen, but whoever listens now finds a flaming projectile lying in wait for him.

10.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
10.en: We do not know whether harm is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends guidance for them.

11.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا
11.en: Among us are the righteous, and among us are others less so—we have been of divided paths.

12.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ نُعْجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا
12.en: We have realized that we can never escape God on earth, nor can we escape Him by fleeing.

13.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
13.en: When we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord will fear neither loss nor oppression.

14.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
14.en: Among us are those who submit, and among us are the unjust. Those who submit have sought the right path.

15.ar: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
15.en: As for the unjust, they will be fuel for Hell.

16.ar: وَأَنْ لَوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُمْ مَاءً غَدَقًا
16.en: Had they stayed on the straight path, We would have given them abundant water to drink.

17.ar: لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَنْ يُعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
17.en: To test them through it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will drive him into an ever-mounting punishment.

18.ar: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا
18.en: The places of worship belong to God, so do not call upon anyone alongside God.

19.ar: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
19.en: When the servant of God stood up calling upon Him, they almost swarmed over him.

20.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُو رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا
20.en: Say, "I call only upon my Lord, and I do not associate anyone with Him."

21.ar: قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
21.en: Say, "I have no power to bring you harm or guidance."

22.ar: قُلْ إِنِّي لَنْ يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا
22.en: Say, "No one can protect me from God, and I will never find any refuge apart from Him."

23.ar: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ ۚ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا
23.en: My only duty is to deliver what comes from God and His messages. Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger—for them is the fire of Hell, where they will remain forever.

24.ar: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
24.en: When they see what they are promised, they will know who has the weaker helpers and the smaller numbers.

25.ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا
25.en: Say, "I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Lord has set a distant time for it."

26.ar: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا
26.en: He is the Knower of the unseen, and He does not reveal His unseen to anyone.

27.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِنْ رَسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا
27.en: Except a messenger He has chosen—then He dispatches guards before him and behind him.

28.ar: لِيَعْلَمَ أَنْ قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا
28.en: So that He may know that they have delivered the messages of their Lord. He encompasses all that is with them and has counted everything in number.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: O you wrapped in garments!

2.en: Stand through the night, except for a little.

3.ar: نِصْفَهُ أَوِ انْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
3.en: Half of it, or reduce from it a little.

4.ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا
4.en: Or add to it, and recite the Quran slowly and distinctly.

5.ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
5.en: We will cast upon you a heavy word.

6.ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
6.en: Rising at night is more impactful and more suitable for words.

7.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
7.en: You have lengthy engagements during the day.

8.ar: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
8.en: Remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him completely.

9.ar: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
9.en: Lord of the East and the West, there is no god but He, so take Him as your Guardian.

10.ar: وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
10.en: Be patient with what they say and leave them gracefully.

11.ar: وَذَرْنِي وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
11.en: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, those living in luxury, and give them a little time.

12.ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنْكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
12.en: With Us are shackles and a blazing fire.

13.ar: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
13.en: Food that chokes and a painful punishment.

14.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَهِيلًا
14.en: On the Day when the earth and mountains will quake, and the mountains become heaps of shifting sand.

15.ar: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
15.en: We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

16.ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
16.en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a crushing grip.

17.ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا
17.en: How will you protect yourselves, if you disbelieve, from a Day that will turn children gray?

18.ar: السَّمَاءُ مُنْفَطِرٌ بِهِ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا
18.en: The sky will be torn apart by it. His promise will be fulfilled.

19.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا
19.en: This is a reminder, so whoever wills may take a path to his Lord.

20.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِنْ ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَنْ لَنْ تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَنْ سَيَكُونُ مِنْكُمْ مَرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
20.en: Your Lord knows that you stand in prayer for nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or a third of it, along with a group of those with you. God measures the night and day. He knows you cannot keep exact count, so He has turned to you in mercy. Recite what is easy for you from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, others traveling through the land seeking God's favor, and others fighting in God's cause. So recite what is easy from it, establish prayer, give charity, and lend to God a good loan. Whatever good you send ahead for yourselves, you will find it with God, better and greater in reward. Seek God's forgiveness. God is Forgiving, Merciful.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: O you wrapped in your cloak!

2.en: Rise and warn!

3.ar: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
3.en: Your Lord, glorify Him!

4.ar: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
4.en: Your garments, purify them!

5.ar: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ
5.en: Defilement, abandon it!

6.ar: وَلَا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِرُ
6.en: Do not give expecting more in return.

7.ar: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ
7.en: For your Lord, be patient.

8.ar: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ
8.en: When the horn is blown.

9.ar: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
9.en: That Day will be a difficult day.

10.ar: عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
10.en: For the disbelievers, far from easy.

11.ar: ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
11.en: Leave Me with the one I created alone.

12.ar: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَمْدُودًا
12.en: I granted him vast wealth.

13.ar: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
13.en: Sons by his side.

14.ar: وَمَهَّدْتُ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا
14.en: I smoothed everything out for him.

15.ar: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
15.en: Then he expects Me to give him more!

16.ar: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِآيَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا
16.en: No! He has been stubborn toward Our verses.

17.ar: سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا
17.en: I will exhaust him with a grueling climb.

18.ar: إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
18.en: He thought and calculated.

19.ar: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
19.en: May he be destroyed! How he calculated!

20.ar: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
20.en: Then may he be destroyed! How he calculated!

21.ar: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
21.en: Then he looked.

22.ar: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
22.en: Then he frowned and scowled.

23.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ
23.en: Then he turned away in arrogance.

24.ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
24.en: He said, "This is nothing but magic passed down."

25.ar: إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ
25.en: "This is nothing but human speech."

26.ar: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
26.en: I will cast him into Saqar.

27.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ
27.en: What will make you realize what Saqar is?

28.ar: لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ
28.en: It spares nothing and leaves nothing behind.

29.ar: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِلْبَشَرِ
29.en: It scorches the flesh.

30.ar: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
30.en: Over it are nineteen.

31.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِيمَانًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
31.en: We have appointed only angels as keepers of the Fire. We made their number a test for the disbelievers, so that those given the Scripture may be certain, and those who believe may increase in faith, and neither those given the Scripture nor the believers will doubt. Those with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will say, "What does God mean by this number?" This is how God leaves astray whoever He wills and guides whoever He wills. None knows the forces of your Lord except Him. This is nothing but a reminder for humanity.

32.ar: كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ
32.en: No! By the moon.

33.ar: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
33.en: By the night as it retreats.

34.ar: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ
34.en: By the dawn as it breaks.

35.ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ
35.en: It is one of the greatest things.

36.ar: نَذِيرًا لِلْبَشَرِ
36.en: A warning to humanity.

37.ar: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
37.en: For whoever among you wishes to advance or fall behind.

38.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
38.en: Every soul is held hostage by what it has committed.

39.ar: إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ
39.en: Except the people of the right.

40.ar: فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
40.en: In gardens, they will ask.

41.ar: عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
41.en: About the criminals.

42.ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ
42.en: "What drove you into Saqar?"

43.ar: قَالُوا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ
43.en: They will say, "We were not among those who prayed."

44.ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ
44.en: "We did not feed the poor."

45.ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ
45.en: "We used to indulge in vain talk with those who indulged."

46.ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ
46.en: "We used to deny the Day of Judgment."

47.ar: حَتَّىٰ أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ
47.en: "Until the certainty came to us."

48.ar: فَمَا تَنْفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ
48.en: No intercession from intercessors will benefit them.

49.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
49.en: What is wrong with them that they turn away from the reminder?

50.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُسْتَنْفِرَةٌ
50.en: As if they were wild donkeys fleeing.

51.ar: فَرَّتْ مِنْ قَسْوَرَةٍ
51.en: From a lion.

52.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَةً
52.en: Each one of them wants to be handed scriptures spread open.

53.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ لَا يَخَافُونَ الْآخِرَةَ
53.en: No! They do not fear the Hereafter.

54.ar: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ
54.en: No! This is a reminder.

55.ar: فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ
55.en: Whoever wills may take heed.

56.ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
56.en: They will not take heed unless God wills. He is worthy of being revered and worthy of granting forgiveness.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

2.en: I swear by the self-reproaching soul.

3.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَلَّنْ نَجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ
3.en: Does man think We will not reassemble his bones?

4.ar: بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ
4.en: Yes, We are able to restore even his fingertips.

5.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنْسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ
5.en: But man wants to go on sinning ahead of him.

6.ar: يَسْأَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ
6.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

7.ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ
7.en: When the sight is dazed.

8.ar: وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ
8.en: The moon is eclipsed.

9.ar: وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ
9.en: The sun and moon are joined together.

10.ar: يَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ
10.en: On that Day man will cry, "Where is the escape?"

11.ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
11.en: No! There is no refuge.

12.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ
12.en: To your Lord is the final destination that Day.

13.ar: يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
13.en: On that Day man will be informed of what he sent ahead and what he left behind.

14.ar: بَلِ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ
14.en: Man will be a witness against himself.

15.ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ
15.en: Even if he throws out his excuses.

16.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ
16.en: Do not move your tongue with it to hasten it.

17.ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ
17.en: It is upon Us to collect it and recite it.

18.ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ
18.en: So when We recite it, follow its recitation.

19.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ
19.en: Then it is upon Us to make it clear.

20.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ
20.en: No! You love the immediate life.

21.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ الْآخِرَةَ
21.en: You abandon the Hereafter.

22.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ
22.en: Some faces that Day will be radiant.

23.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
23.en: Looking at their Lord.

24.ar: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ
24.en: Some faces that Day will be grim.

25.ar: تَظُنُّ أَنْ يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
25.en: Expecting a spine-breaking blow to befall them.

26.ar: كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ
26.en: No! When it reaches the collarbones.

27.ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
27.en: It is said, "Is there any healer?"

28.ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ
28.en: He knows it is the final parting.

29.ar: وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ
29.en: Leg is wrapped around leg.

30.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ
30.en: To your Lord that Day is the driving.

31.ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
31.en: He did not believe, nor did he pray.

32.ar: وَلَٰكِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
32.en: But he denied and turned away.

33.ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰ
33.en: Then he went to his family, strutting.

34.ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
34.en: Woe to you, and woe!

35.ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
35.en: Then woe to you, and woe!

36.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
36.en: Does man think he will be left aimless?

37.ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِنْ مَنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
37.en: Was he not a drop of emitted fluid?

38.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
38.en: Then he became a clinging clot, and He created and formed.

39.ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَىٰ
39.en: Then He made from him the two mates: male and female.

40.ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ
40.en: Is He not able to give life to the dead?

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ حِينٌ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْئًا مَذْكُورًا
1.en: Has there not come upon man a period of time when he was nothing worth mentioning?

2.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا
2.en: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to test him, and We made him hearing and seeing.

3.ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
3.en: We showed him the path, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.

4.ar: إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلَاسِلَ وَأَغْلَالًا وَسَعِيرًا
4.en: We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing fire.

5.ar: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِنْ كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
5.en: The righteous will drink from a cup mixed with camphor.

6.ar: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
6.en: A spring from which the servants of God will drink, making it gush forth abundantly.

7.ar: يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا
7.en: They fulfill their vows and fear a Day whose evil spreads far and wide.

8.ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
8.en: They feed the poor, the orphan, and the captive out of love for Him.

9.ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
9.en: "We feed you only for the Face of God. We want no reward from you, nor any thanks.

10.ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنْ رَبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
10.en: We fear from our Lord a Day, grim and devastating."

11.ar: فَوَقَاهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
11.en: So God protected them from the evil of that Day and granted them radiance and joy.

12.ar: وَجَزَاهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوا جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
12.en: He rewarded them for their patience with a garden and silk.

13.ar: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
13.en: Reclining there on couches, they will see neither scorching sun nor bitter cold.

14.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
14.en: Its shade will hang low over them, and its fruit clusters will be brought within easy reach.

15.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِآنِيَةٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا
15.en: They will be served with vessels of silver and cups of crystal.

16.ar: قَوَارِيرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
16.en: Crystal of silver, measured to perfection.

17.ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنْجَبِيلًا
17.en: They will be given a cup to drink, mixed with ginger.

18.ar: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
18.en: From a spring there called Salsabil.

19.ar: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَنْثُورًا
19.en: Eternal youths will circulate among them. When you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.

20.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
20.en: When you look around, you will see bliss and a vast kingdom.

21.ar: عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوا أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
21.en: They will wear garments of green silk and brocade. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

22.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَشْكُورًا
22.en: "This is your reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

23.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ تَنْزِيلًا
23.en: We have sent down the Quran to you in stages.

24.ar: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ آثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
24.en: So be patient for the judgment of your Lord, and do not obey any sinner or ungrateful one among them.

25.ar: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
25.en: Remember the name of your Lord morning and evening.

26.ar: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
26.en: During the night, prostrate to Him and glorify Him through the long night.

27.ar: إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
27.en: These people love the fleeting world and leave behind them a heavy Day.

28.ar: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
28.en: We created them and strengthened their forms. Whenever We will, We can replace them with others like them.

29.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا
29.en: This is a reminder. Whoever wills may take a path to his Lord.

30.ar: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
30.en: But you cannot will unless God wills. God is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

31.ar: يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
31.en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By those sent forth in succession.

2.en: Then raging in tempest.

3.ar: وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا
3.en: And spreading far and wide.

4.ar: فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا
4.en: Then separating with distinction.

5.ar: فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا
5.en: Then delivering a reminder.

6.ar: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
6.en: As excuse or warning.

7.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ
7.en: What you are promised will surely come to pass.

8.ar: فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
8.en: When the stars are extinguished.

9.ar: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ
9.en: When the sky is torn open.

10.ar: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
10.en: When the mountains are blown away.

11.ar: وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
11.en: When the messengers are given their appointed time.

12.ar: لِأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
12.en: For what Day have they been delayed?

13.ar: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ
13.en: For the Day of Distinction.

14.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ
14.en: What will make you realize what the Day of Distinction is?

15.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
15.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

16.ar: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ
16.en: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

17.ar: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْآخِرِينَ
17.en: Then We will make the later ones follow them.

18.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ
18.en: This is how We deal with the wicked.

19.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
19.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

20.ar: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُمْ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ
20.en: Did We not create you from a worthless fluid?

21.ar: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ
21.en: Then We placed it in a secure resting place.

22.ar: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ
22.en: Until a known term.

23.ar: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ
23.en: We determined it, and how excellent are We at determining.

24.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
24.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

25.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
25.en: Did We not make the earth a container.

26.ar: أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا
26.en: For the living and the dead?

27.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمْ مَاءً فُرَاتًا
27.en: We placed on it towering mountains and gave you fresh water to drink.

28.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
28.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

29.ar: انْطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
29.en: Proceed to what you used to deny.

30.ar: انْطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ
30.en: Proceed to a shadow of three columns.

31.ar: لَا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ
31.en: Giving no shade and no protection from the flames.

32.ar: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ
32.en: It hurls sparks as huge as palaces.

33.ar: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ
33.en: Like tawny camels.

34.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
34.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

35.ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ
35.en: This is a Day when they will not speak.

36.ar: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
36.en: Nor will they be permitted to make excuses.

37.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
37.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

38.ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ
38.en: This is the Day of Distinction. We have gathered you and the former peoples.

39.ar: فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
39.en: So if you have a scheme, then scheme against Me.

40.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
40.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

41.ar: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ
41.en: Those who were mindful of God will be amid shades and springs.

42.ar: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
42.en: And fruits of whatever they desire.

43.ar: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
43.en: Eat and drink with pleasure for what you used to do.

44.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
44.en: This is how We reward those who do good.

45.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
45.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

46.ar: كُلُوا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُجْرِمُونَ
46.en: Eat and enjoy yourselves a little, for you are wicked.

47.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
47.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

48.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
48.en: When they are told to bow down, they do not bow.

49.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
49.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

50.ar: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ
50.en: In what message after this will they believe?

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: What are they asking one another about?

2.en: About the momentous news.

3.ar: الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
3.en: The one over which they disagree.

4.ar: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
4.en: No! They will come to know.

5.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
5.en: Then again, no! They will come to know.

6.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ مِهَادًا
6.en: Did We not make the earth a resting place?

7.ar: وَالْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
7.en: And the mountains as stakes?

8.ar: وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا
8.en: And We created you in pairs.

9.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
9.en: And We made your sleep for rest.

10.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
10.en: And We made the night a covering.

11.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
11.en: And We made the day for livelihood.

12.ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
12.en: And We built above you seven firm ones.

13.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
13.en: And We placed a blazing lamp.

14.ar: وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَاءً ثَجَّاجًا
14.en: And We sent down from the rain clouds water pouring in torrents.

15.ar: لِنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
15.en: To bring forth with it grain and vegetation.

16.ar: وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا
16.en: And gardens dense with growth.

17.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا
17.en: The Day of Separation has an appointed time.

18.ar: يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
18.en: The Day the Horn is blown and you come forth in crowds.

19.ar: وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا
19.en: The sky is opened and becomes gateways.

20.ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
20.en: The mountains are set in motion and become a mirage.

21.ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
21.en: Hell lies in ambush.

22.ar: لِلطَّاغِينَ مَآبًا
22.en: A destination for the transgressors.

23.ar: لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا
23.en: They will remain there for ages.

24.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
24.en: They will taste there neither coolness nor drink.

25.ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
25.en: Except scalding water and oozing pus.

26.ar: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا
26.en: A fitting recompense.

27.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
27.en: They never expected a reckoning.

28.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّابًا
28.en: They utterly denied Our verses.

29.ar: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا
29.en: But We have recorded everything in a book.

30.ar: فَذُوقُوا فَلَنْ نَزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
30.en: So taste! We will only increase you in punishment.

31.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
31.en: For the mindful there is triumph.

32.ar: حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا
32.en: Gardens and vineyards.

33.ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
33.en: And full-breasted companions of equal age.

34.ar: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
34.en: And cups filled to the brim.

35.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا
35.en: They will hear there no idle talk and no lies.

36.ar: جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا
36.en: A reward from your Lord, a calculated gift.

37.ar: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
37.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them, the Most Merciful. They possess no authority to address Him.

38.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
38.en: The Day the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, none will speak except those permitted by the Most Merciful, and they will say only what is right.

39.ar: ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآبًا
39.en: That is the True Day. So whoever wills, let him take a path back to his Lord.

40.ar: إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا
40.en: We have warned you of a punishment close at hand, the Day when a person will see what his own hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will cry, "If only I were dust!"

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By those who tear out violently.

2.en: By those who draw out gently.

3.ar: وَالسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحًا
3.en: By those who glide swiftly.

4.ar: فَالسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقًا
4.en: By those who race ahead.

5.ar: فَالْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْرًا
5.en: By those who manage affairs.

6.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ
6.en: The Day the quaking blast strikes.

7.ar: تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ
7.en: Followed by the second blast.

8.ar: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
8.en: Hearts that Day will pound.

9.ar: أَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ
9.en: Their eyes cast down.

10.ar: يَقُولُونَ أَإِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ
10.en: They say, "Will we really be returned to our former state?

11.ar: أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَخِرَةً
11.en: Even after we are decayed bones?

12.ar: قَالُوا تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
12.en: They say, "That would be a losing return.

13.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
13.en: It will be just one blast.

14.ar: فَإِذَا هُمْ بِالسَّاهِرَةِ
14.en: Then suddenly they will be on the open plain.

15.ar: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ
15.en: Has the story of Moses reached you?

16.ar: إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
16.en: When his Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

17.ar: اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ
17.en: Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed.

18.ar: فَقُلْ هَلْ لَكَ إِلَىٰ أَنْ تَزَكَّىٰ
18.en: Say to him, "Would you like to purify yourself?

19.ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
19.en: I will guide you to your Lord so you may stand in awe of Him.

20.ar: فَأَرَاهُ الْآيَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ
20.en: He showed him the greatest sign.

21.ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
21.en: But he denied and disobeyed.

22.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
22.en: Then he turned away, striving.

23.ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
23.en: He gathered his people and called out.

24.ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْأَعْلَىٰ
24.en: He said, "I am your lord, the most high."

25.ar: فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّهُ نَكَالَ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَىٰ
25.en: So God seized him with the punishment of the Hereafter and this life.

26.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِمَنْ يَخْشَىٰ
26.en: In this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe.

27.ar: أَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ ۚ بَنَاهَا
27.en: Are you harder to create or the sky? He built it.

28.ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّاهَا
28.en: He raised its canopy and perfected it.

29.ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَاهَا
29.en: He darkened its night and brought forth its daylight.

30.ar: وَالْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَاهَا
30.en: The earth after that He spread out.

31.ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَاءَهَا وَمَرْعَاهَا
31.en: He brought forth from it its water and its pasture.

32.ar: وَالْجِبَالَ أَرْسَاهَا
32.en: The mountains He anchored firmly.

33.ar: مَتَاعًا لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ
33.en: A provision for you and your livestock.

34.ar: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الطَّامَّةُ الْكُبْرَىٰ
34.en: When the overwhelming catastrophe arrives.

35.ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ
35.en: The Day when man will remember all that he strove for.

36.ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِمَنْ يَرَىٰ
36.en: Hell will be brought into full view for all to see.

37.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ طَغَىٰ
37.en: Whoever transgressed.

38.ar: وَآثَرَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
38.en: And preferred the life of this world.

39.ar: فَإِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ
39.en: Hell will be their refuge.

40.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ
40.en: But whoever feared standing before their Lord and restrained the soul from its desires.

41.ar: فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ
41.en: Paradise will be their refuge.

42.ar: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا
42.en: They ask you about the Hour: when will it arrive?

43.ar: فِيمَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْرَاهَا
43.en: What do you have to do with its timing?

44.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهَاهَا
44.en: To your Lord is its end.

45.ar: إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ مَنْ يَخْشَاهَا
45.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

46.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا
46.en: The Day they see it, it will seem as if they had stayed only an evening or its morning.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: He frowned and turned away.

2.en: Because the blind man came to him.

3.ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ
3.en: What would make you know? Perhaps he would purify himself.

4.ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنْفَعَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ
4.en: Or be reminded, and the reminder would benefit him.

5.ar: أَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنَىٰ
5.en: As for the one who considers himself self-sufficient.

6.ar: فَأَنْتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ
6.en: You give him your attention.

7.ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
7.en: Yet it is not your concern if he does not purify himself.

8.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ جَاءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
8.en: But as for the one who came to you striving.

9.ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
9.en: While he fears.

10.ar: فَأَنْتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
10.en: From him you are distracted.

11.ar: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
11.en: No! This is a reminder.

12.ar: فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ
12.en: So whoever wills may remember it.

13.ar: فِي صُحُفٍ مُكَرَّمَةٍ
13.en: In honored scriptures.

14.ar: مَرْفُوعَةٍ مُطَهَّرَةٍ
14.en: Exalted and purified.

15.ar: بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ
15.en: In the hands of scribes.

16.ar: كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ
16.en: Noble and righteous.

17.ar: قُتِلَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا أَكْفَرَهُ
17.en: Cursed is man! How ungrateful he is!

18.ar: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ
18.en: From what thing did He create him?

19.ar: مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ
19.en: From a drop of fluid He created him and proportioned him.

20.ar: ثُمَّ السَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ
20.en: Then He made the path easy for him.

21.ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ
21.en: Then He caused him to die and buried him.

22.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَاءَ أَنْشَرَهُ
22.en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

23.ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ
23.en: No! He has not yet fulfilled what He commanded him.

24.ar: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ
24.en: Let man look at his food.

25.ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا
25.en: We poured down water in abundance.

26.ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
26.en: Then We split the earth open.

27.ar: فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
27.en: And We caused grain to grow in it.

28.ar: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
28.en: And grapes and fresh vegetation.

29.ar: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
29.en: And olives and date palms.

30.ar: وَحَدَائِقَ غُلْبًا
30.en: And dense gardens.

31.ar: وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
31.en: And fruits and pastures.

32.ar: مَتَاعًا لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ
32.en: Provision for you and your livestock.

33.ar: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الصَّاخَّةُ
33.en: When the Deafening Blast comes.

34.ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
34.en: The Day a man will flee from his brother.

35.ar: وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ
35.en: And his mother and his father.

36.ar: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ
36.en: And his wife and his children.

37.ar: لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
37.en: Every one of them that Day will have enough concern of his own.

38.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُسْفِرَةٌ
38.en: Faces that Day will be radiant.

39.ar: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
39.en: Laughing, rejoicing.

40.ar: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
40.en: And faces that Day will be covered with dust.

41.ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
41.en: Veiled in darkness.

42.ar: أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ
42.en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: When the sun is wrapped up.

2.en: When the stars fall and scatter.

3.ar: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
3.en: When the mountains are set in motion.

4.ar: وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
4.en: When pregnant camels are abandoned.

5.ar: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
5.en: When wild beasts are gathered together.

6.ar: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
6.en: When the seas are set ablaze.

7.ar: وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
7.en: When souls are paired.

8.ar: وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ
8.en: When the baby girl buried alive is asked.

9.ar: بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ
9.en: For what crime was she killed?

10.ar: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
10.en: When the records are laid open.

11.ar: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ
11.en: When the sky is stripped away.

12.ar: وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
12.en: When Hell is set blazing.

13.ar: وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
13.en: When Paradise is brought near.

14.ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا أَحْضَرَتْ
14.en: Every soul will know what it has brought.

15.ar: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ
15.en: I swear by the retreating stars.

16.ar: الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ
16.en: Those that travel and hide.

17.ar: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
17.en: By the night as it departs.

18.ar: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
18.en: By the dawn as it breathes.

19.ar: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
19.en: This is the word of a noble messenger.

20.ar: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
20.en: Possessing power, secure with the Lord of the Throne.

21.ar: مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
21.en: Obeyed there, and trustworthy.

22.ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ
22.en: Your companion is not mad.

23.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ
23.en: He saw him on the clear horizon.

24.ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
24.en: He is not withholding of the unseen.

25.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ
25.en: This is not the word of an outcast devil.

26.ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
26.en: So where are you going?

27.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ
27.en: This is nothing but a reminder to all worlds.

28.ar: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ
28.en: For whoever among you wills to take a straight path.

29.ar: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
29.en: But you cannot will unless God wills, the Lord of all worlds.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: When the sky is split open.

2.en: When the stars are scattered.

3.ar: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
3.en: When the seas are burst forth.

4.ar: وَإِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
4.en: When the graves are overturned.

5.ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
5.en: Every soul will know what it sent ahead and what it left behind.

6.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ
6.en: O human being, what has deceived you about your Generous Lord?

7.ar: الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
7.en: He who created you, shaped you, and proportioned you.

8.ar: فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
8.en: In whatever form He willed, He assembled you.

9.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدِّينِ
9.en: No! Rather, you deny the Judgment.

10.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ
10.en: Yet over you are guardians.

11.ar: كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ
11.en: Noble scribes.

12.ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
12.en: They know everything you do.

13.ar: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
13.en: The righteous will be in bliss.

14.ar: وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ
14.en: The wicked will be in Hell.

15.ar: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ
15.en: They will burn in it on the Day of Judgment.

16.ar: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَائِبِينَ
16.en: And they will not be absent from it.

17.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
17.en: What will make you realize what the Day of Judgment is?

18.ar: ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
18.en: Then again, what will make you realize what the Day of Judgment is?

19.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا ۖ وَالْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
19.en: A Day when no soul can do anything for another soul, and all authority that Day belongs to God.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Woe to those who give short measure.

2.ar: الَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
2.en: Those who, when they take a measure from people, take it in full.

3.ar: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
3.en: But when they measure or weigh for others, they give less.

4.ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُولَٰئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ
4.en: Do they not think they will be resurrected?

5.ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
5.en: For a tremendous Day.

6.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
6.en: The Day when all people will stand before the Lord of all worlds.

7.ar: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
7.en: No! The record of the wicked is in Sijjin.

8.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
8.en: What will make you realize what Sijjin is?

9.ar: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ
9.en: A written record.

10.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
10.en: Woe on that Day to the deniers.

11.ar: الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ
11.en: Those who deny the Day of Judgment.

12.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
12.en: None denies it except every sinful transgressor.

13.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
13.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Ancient fables!"

14.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
14.en: No! Rather, what they committed has rusted over their hearts.

15.ar: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ
15.en: No! On that Day they will be veiled from their Lord.

16.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُو الْجَحِيمِ
16.en: Then they will burn in Hell.

17.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
17.en: Then it will be said, "This is what you used to deny."

18.ar: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
18.en: No! The record of the righteous is in Illiyyin.

19.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
19.en: What will make you realize what Illiyyoun is?

20.ar: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ
20.en: A written record.

21.ar: يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ
21.en: Witnessed by those brought near.

22.ar: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
22.en: The righteous will be in bliss.

23.ar: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ
23.en: On couches, gazing.

24.ar: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ
24.en: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of bliss.

25.ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِنْ رَحِيقٍ مَخْتُومٍ
25.en: They will be given sealed wine to drink.

26.ar: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
26.en: Its seal is musk. So let the competitors compete for this.

27.ar: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِنْ تَسْنِيمٍ
27.en: Its mixture is from Tasnim.

28.ar: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ
28.en: A spring from which those brought near will drink.

29.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَضْحَكُونَ
29.en: Those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

30.ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
30.en: When they passed by them, they would wink at one another.

31.ar: وَإِذَا انْقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ
31.en: When they returned to their own people, they returned amused.

32.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَضَالُّونَ
32.en: When they saw them, they would say, "These people are truly lost."

33.ar: وَمَا أُرْسِلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ
33.en: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

34.ar: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
34.en: So today, those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers.

35.ar: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ
35.en: On couches, gazing.

36.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
36.en: Have the disbelievers been repaid for what they used to do?

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: When the sky splits open.

2.en: And it heeds its Lord, as it must.

3.ar: وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
3.en: When the earth is stretched out.

4.ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
4.en: And it casts out all that is within it and becomes empty.

5.ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
5.en: And it heeds its Lord, as it must.

6.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ
6.en: O human being, you are laboring toward your Lord with great effort, and you will meet Him.

7.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
7.en: As for the one who is given his record in his right hand.

8.ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
8.en: He will have an easy reckoning.

9.ar: وَيَنْقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
9.en: And he will return to his people joyful.

10.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ
10.en: But as for the one who is given his record behind his back.

11.ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُو ثُبُورًا
11.en: He will cry out for destruction.

12.ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
12.en: And he will burn in a blazing fire.

13.ar: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
13.en: He used to be joyful among his people.

14.ar: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ يَحُورَ
14.en: He thought he would never return.

15.ar: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا
15.en: But yes, his Lord was watching him.

16.ar: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ
16.en: I swear by the twilight glow.

17.ar: وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
17.en: And the night and all it envelops.

18.ar: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا اتَّسَقَ
18.en: And the moon when it becomes full.

19.ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ
19.en: You will surely pass from stage to stage.

20.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
20.en: So what is wrong with them that they do not believe?

21.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
21.en: When the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down.

22.ar: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُكَذِّبُونَ
22.en: No, those who disbelieve persist in denial.

23.ar: وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
23.en: God knows best what they harbor within.

24.ar: فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
24.en: So give them news of a painful punishment.

25.ar: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
25.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds: for them is a reward unending.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the sky with its towering constellations.

2.en: By the promised Day.

3.ar: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
3.en: By the witness and the witnessed.

4.ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ الْأُخْدُودِ
4.en: Destroyed were the makers of the trench.

5.ar: النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ
5.en: The fire, abundantly fueled.

6.ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
6.en: When they sat beside it.

7.ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
7.en: They were witnesses to what they were doing to the believers.

8.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
8.en: They resented them only because they believed in God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.

9.ar: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
9.en: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and God is Witness over all things.

10.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ
10.en: Those who persecuted the believing men and women, then did not repent, will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of burning.

11.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ
11.en: Those who believe and do good deeds will have gardens with rivers flowing beneath them. That is the great triumph.

12.ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
12.en: Your Lord's grip is fierce.

13.ar: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
13.en: He is the One who originates and restores.

14.ar: وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ
14.en: He is the Forgiving, the Loving.

15.ar: ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ
15.en: Lord of the Glorious Throne.

16.ar: فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ
16.en: Doer of whatever He wills.

17.ar: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْجُنُودِ
17.en: Has the story of the forces reached you?

18.ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
18.en: Pharaoh and Thamud?

19.ar: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي تَكْذِيبٍ
19.en: Yet those who disbelieve persist in denial.

20.ar: وَاللَّهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ مُحِيطٌ
20.en: God surrounds them from all sides.

21.ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَجِيدٌ
21.en: This is a glorious Quran.

22.ar: فِي لَوْحٍ مَحْفُوظٍ
22.en: In a Preserved Tablet.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the sky and the night-comer.

2.en: What will make you realize what the night-comer is?

3.ar: النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ
3.en: The piercing star.

4.ar: إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
4.en: Every soul has a guardian over it.

5.ar: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
5.en: Let the human being reflect on what he was created from.

6.ar: خُلِقَ مِنْ مَاءٍ دَافِقٍ
6.en: He was created from a gushing fluid.

7.ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ
7.en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

8.ar: إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ
8.en: He is fully capable of bringing him back.

9.ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ
9.en: On the Day when secrets are exposed.

10.ar: فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
10.en: Then he will have no strength and no helper.

11.ar: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ
11.en: By the sky that returns.

12.ar: وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ
12.en: By the earth that splits open.

13.ar: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
13.en: This is a decisive word.

14.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ
14.en: It is no joke.

15.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
15.en: They are plotting a scheme.

16.ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
16.en: I am plotting a scheme.

17.ar: فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا
17.en: So give the disbelievers respite. Let them be for a little while.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.

2.en: Who created and proportioned.

3.ar: وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
3.en: Who determined and guided.

4.ar: وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ
4.en: Who brought forth the pasture.

5.ar: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ
5.en: Then turned it to dark debris.

6.ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنْسَىٰ
6.en: We will make you read, and you will not forget.

7.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
7.en: Except what God wills. He knows what is open and what is hidden.

8.ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
8.en: We will ease you toward ease.

9.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنْ نَفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَىٰ
9.en: So remind, if the reminder benefits.

10.ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَنْ يَخْشَىٰ
10.en: The one who fears will take heed.

11.ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْأَشْقَى
11.en: But the most wretched will avoid it.

12.ar: الَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرَىٰ
12.en: The one who will burn in the gigantic Fire.

13.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
13.en: Then he will neither die in it nor live.

14.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكَّىٰ
14.en: Successful is the one who purifies himself.

15.ar: وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ
15.en: And remembers the name of his Lord and prays.

16.ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
16.en: But you prefer the life of this world.

17.ar: وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
17.en: While the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

18.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ
18.en: This is in the ancient scriptures.

19.ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
19.en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you?

2.en: Faces that Day will be humbled.

3.ar: عَامِلَةٌ نَاصِبَةٌ
3.en: Laboring, exhausted.

4.ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
4.en: Burning in a scorching fire.

5.ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ
5.en: Given to drink from a boiling spring.

6.ar: لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ ضَرِيعٍ
6.en: They will have no food except bitter thorns.

7.ar: لَا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنْ جُوعٍ
7.en: It neither nourishes nor satisfies hunger.

8.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاعِمَةٌ
8.en: Faces that Day will be radiant.

9.ar: لِسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
9.en: Pleased with their striving.

10.ar: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
10.en: In a lofty Paradise.

11.ar: لَا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً
11.en: Where they hear no idle talk.

12.ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
12.en: In it is a flowing spring.

13.ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَرْفُوعَةٌ
13.en: In it are raised couches.

14.ar: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَوْضُوعَةٌ
14.en: Goblets set ready.

15.ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
15.en: Cushions lined up.

16.ar: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
16.en: Fine carpets spread out.

17.ar: أَفَلَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
17.en: Do they not look at the camels, how they were created?

18.ar: وَإِلَى السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
18.en: At the sky, how it was raised?

19.ar: وَإِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
19.en: At the mountains, how they were anchored?

20.ar: وَإِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
20.en: At the earth, how it was spread out?

21.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
21.en: So remind, for you are only a reminder.

22.ar: لَسْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
22.en: You have no control over them.

23.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
23.en: But whoever turns away and disbelieves.

24.ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللَّهُ الْعَذَابَ الْأَكْبَرَ
24.en: God will punish him with the greatest punishment.

25.ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ
25.en: To Us is their return.

26.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُمْ
26.en: Then upon Us is their reckoning.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the dawn.

2.en: By the ten nights.

3.ar: وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ
3.en: By the even and the odd.

4.ar: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
4.en: By the night as it slips away.

5.ar: هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذِي حِجْرٍ
5.en: Is there not in this an oath for one with understanding?

6.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
6.en: Have you not seen what your Lord did to Aad?

7.ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ
7.en: Iram of the towering pillars.

8.ar: الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ
8.en: The likes of which had never been created in any land.

9.ar: وَثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ
9.en: And Thamud, who carved the rocks in the valley.

10.ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْأَوْتَادِ
10.en: And Pharaoh of the stakes.

11.ar: الَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ
11.en: All of them transgressed throughout the lands.

12.ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ
12.en: And spread much corruption in them.

13.ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
13.en: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

14.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ
14.en: Your Lord is ever watchful.

15.ar: فَأَمَّا الْإِنْسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ
15.en: As for the human being, when his Lord tests him by honoring him and blessing him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

16.ar: وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ
16.en: But when He tests him by restricting his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

17.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ لَا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ
17.en: No! Rather, you do not honor the orphan.

18.ar: وَلَا تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
18.en: You do not urge one another to feed the poor.

19.ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَمًّا
19.en: You devour inheritance with greedy consumption.

20.ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
20.en: You love wealth with excessive love.

21.ar: كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
21.en: No! When the earth is crushed, pounded and pounded.

22.ar: وَجَاءَ رَبُّكَ وَالْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
22.en: Your Lord arrives, and the angels rank upon rank.

23.ar: وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ
23.en: On that Day, Hell is brought near. On that Day, the human being will remember, but what good will remembering do him?

24.ar: يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي
24.en: He will say, "If only I had sent ahead something for my life!"

25.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ
25.en: On that Day, none will punish as He punishes.

26.ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ
26.en: None will bind as He binds.

27.ar: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
27.en: O tranquil soul!

28.ar: ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَرْضِيَّةً
28.en: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing.

29.ar: فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي
29.en: Enter among My servants.

30.ar: وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي
30.en: Enter My Paradise.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: I swear by this city.

2.en: And you are free of restriction in this city.

3.ar: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
3.en: And by the father and what he fathered.

4.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ فِي كَبَدٍ
4.en: We created the human being in hardship.

5.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَنْ يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
5.en: Does he think no one has power over him?

6.ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُبَدًا
6.en: He says, "I have spent heaps of wealth."

7.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ
7.en: Does he think no one saw him?

8.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ عَيْنَيْنِ
8.en: Did We not give him two eyes?

9.ar: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
9.en: A tongue and two lips?

10.ar: وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ
10.en: And guided him to the two paths?

11.ar: فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ
11.en: Yet he has not attempted the steep climb.

12.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ
12.en: What will make you realize what the steep climb is?

13.ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
13.en: It is freeing a slave.

14.ar: أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ
14.en: Or feeding on a day of hunger.

15.ar: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
15.en: An orphan who is a relative.

16.ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ
16.en: Or a destitute person in the dust.

17.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ
17.en: Then being among those who believe and urge one another to patience and urge one another to compassion.

18.ar: أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ
18.en: These are the people of the right.

19.ar: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ
19.en: But those who reject Our signs are the people of the left.

20.ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُؤْصَدَةٌ
20.en: Over them is a Fire sealed shut.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the sun and its morning brightness.

2.en: By the moon as it follows it.

3.ar: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا
3.en: By the day as it reveals it.

4.ar: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا
4.en: By the night as it covers it.

5.ar: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا
5.en: By the sky and He who built it.

6.ar: وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا
6.en: By the earth and He who spread it.

7.ar: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا
7.en: By the soul and He who shaped it.

8.ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا
8.en: Then inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness.

9.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا
9.en: Successful is the one who purifies it.

10.ar: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا
10.en: And ruined is the one who corrupts it.

11.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا
11.en: Thamud denied in their transgression.

12.ar: إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا
12.en: When the most wretched among them rose up.

13.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا
13.en: The messenger of God said to them, "The she-camel of God and her right to drink."

14.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا
14.en: But they rejected him and hamstrung her, so their Lord crushed them for their sin and leveled them.

15.ar: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا
15.en: He fears no consequence.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the night as it covers.

2.en: By the day as it reveals.

3.ar: وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَىٰ
3.en: By the One who created male and female.

4.ar: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
4.en: Your efforts are truly diverse.

5.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَاتَّقَىٰ
5.en: As for the one who gives and is mindful of God.

6.ar: وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ
6.en: And believes in the ultimate good.

7.ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
7.en: We will ease his way to ease.

8.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَىٰ
8.en: But as for the one who withholds and considers himself self-sufficient.

9.ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ
9.en: And denies the ultimate good.

10.ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
10.en: We will ease his way to hardship.

11.ar: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ
11.en: His wealth will not help him when he plunges.

12.ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
12.en: Guidance is upon Us.

13.ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَىٰ
13.en: To Us belongs the Hereafter and the present life.

14.ar: فَأَنْذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
14.en: So I have warned you of a Fire that blazes.

15.ar: لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى
15.en: None will burn in it except the most wretched.

16.ar: الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
16.en: The one who denied and turned away.

17.ar: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى
17.en: But the most reverent will be kept far from it.

18.ar: الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
18.en: The one who gives his wealth to purify himself.

19.ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ
19.en: Not to repay anyone for a favor owed.

20.ar: إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْأَعْلَىٰ
20.en: But only seeking the Face of his Lord, the Most High.

21.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
21.en: And he will surely be satisfied.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the morning light.

2.en: And by the night when it grows still.

3.ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
3.en: Your Lord has not abandoned you, nor does He despise you.

4.ar: وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ
4.en: The Hereafter is better for you than this present life.

5.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ
5.en: Your Lord will give to you, and you will be satisfied.

6.ar: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ
6.en: Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?

7.ar: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ
7.en: He found you lost and guided you.

8.ar: وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
8.en: He found you in need and made you self-sufficient.

9.ar: فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
9.en: So do not oppress the orphan.

10.ar: وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
10.en: And do not turn away the one who asks.

11.ar: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
11.en: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Did We not expand your chest for you?

2.en: We lifted from you your burden.

3.ar: الَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
3.en: The one that broke your back.

4.ar: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
4.en: We raised high your name.

5.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
5.en: With hardship comes ease.

6.ar: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
6.en: With hardship comes ease.

7.ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ
7.en: So when you are finished, strive on.

8.ar: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ
8.en: To your Lord, turn with longing.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the fig and the olive.

2.en: By Mount Sinai.

3.ar: وَهَٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ
3.en: By this secure city.

4.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
4.en: We created the human being in the finest form.

5.ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ
5.en: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low.

6.ar: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
6.en: Except those who believe and do good deeds, for them is a reward unending.

7.ar: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ
7.en: So what makes you deny the Judgment after this?

8.ar: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ
8.en: Is God not the most just of judges?

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Read in the name of your Lord who created.

2.en: Created the human being from a clinging clot.

3.ar: اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ
3.en: Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous.

4.ar: الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ
4.en: He who taught by the pen.

5.ar: عَلَّمَ الْإِنْسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
5.en: Taught the human being what he did not know.
