6.ar: كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغَىٰ
6.en: No, the human being truly transgresses.

7.ar: أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنَىٰ
7.en: When he sees himself self-sufficient.

8.ar: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَىٰ
8.en: To your Lord is the return.

9.ar: أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَىٰ
9.en: Have you seen the one who forbids.

10.ar: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰ
10.en: A servant when he prays?

11.ar: أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰ
11.en: Have you considered if he is upon guidance.

12.ar: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَىٰ
12.en: Or commands righteousness?

13.ar: أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
13.en: Have you considered if he denies and turns away?

14.ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
14.en: Does he not know that God sees?

15.ar: كَلَّا لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ
15.en: No! If he does not stop, We will drag him by the forelock.

16.ar: نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ
16.en: A lying, sinful forelock.

17.ar: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ
17.en: Let him call his council.

18.ar: سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ
18.en: We will call the guards of Hell.

19.ar: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِبْ ۩
19.en: No! Do not obey him. Prostrate and draw near.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: We sent it down on the Night of Decree.

2.en: What will make you realize what the Night of Decree is?

3.ar: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
3.en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

4.ar: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
4.en: The angels and the Spirit descend in it, by their Lord's permission, with every command.

5.ar: سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ
5.en: It is peace until the rising of dawn.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنْفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
1.en: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not going to desist until the clear proof came to them.

2.ar: رَسُولٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُو صُحُفًا مُطَهَّرَةً
2.en: A messenger from God, reciting purified scriptures.

3.ar: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
3.en: Within them are upright decrees.

4.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
4.en: Those who were given the Scripture did not divide until after the clear proof came to them.

5.ar: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ
5.en: They were only commanded to worship God, devoting their faith sincerely to Him as upright monotheists, and to establish prayer and give charity. That is the upright religion.

6.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ
6.en: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, dwelling there forever. They are the worst of creation.

7.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ
7.en: Those who believed and did righteous deeds, they are the best of creation.

8.ar: جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ
8.en: Their reward with their Lord is gardens of eternal residence, beneath which rivers flow, dwelling there forever. God is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever stands in awe of his Lord.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: When the earth is shaken with its ultimate quaking.

2.en: The earth will throw out its burdens.

3.ar: وَقَالَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا لَهَا
3.en: Man will cry, "What is wrong with it?"

4.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
4.en: On that Day, it will tell its stories.

5.ar: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
5.en: Because your Lord will have inspired it.

6.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ
6.en: On that Day, people will come forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.

7.ar: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
7.en: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.

8.ar: وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
8.en: Whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By the charging horses, panting.

2.en: Striking sparks with their hooves.

3.ar: فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا
3.en: Raiding at dawn.

4.ar: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا
4.en: Raising clouds of dust.

5.ar: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا
5.en: Plunging into the midst of the gathering.

6.ar: إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ
6.en: The human being is truly ungrateful to his Lord.

7.ar: وَإِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
7.en: He himself is a witness to that.

8.ar: وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
8.en: He is fierce in his love of wealth.

9.ar: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ
9.en: Does he not know that when the graves are overturned.

10.ar: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ
10.en: And what is in the hearts is exposed.

11.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّهُمْ بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَخَبِيرٌ
11.en: Their Lord, on that Day, will be fully aware of them.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: The Striking Calamity.

2.en: What is the Striking Calamity?

3.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ
3.en: What could make you realize what the Striking Calamity is?

4.ar: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ
4.en: The Day when people will be like scattered moths.

5.ar: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ الْمَنْفُوشِ
5.en: The mountains will be like tufts of carded wool.

6.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ
6.en: As for the one whose scales are heavy.

7.ar: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَاضِيَةٍ
7.en: He will be in a pleasant life.

8.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ
8.en: But as for the one whose scales are light.

9.ar: فَأُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ
9.en: His mother will be the Abyss.

10.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا هِيَهْ
10.en: What could make you realize what it is?

11.ar: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌ
11.en: A blazing Fire.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: The race for more has distracted you.

2.en: Until you visit the graves.

3.ar: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
3.en: No! You will come to know.

4.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
4.en: Then no! You will come to know.

5.ar: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ
5.en: No! If only you knew with certain knowledge.

6.ar: لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ
6.en: You will surely see Hell.

7.ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ
7.en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

8.ar: ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ
8.en: Then on that Day you will surely be questioned about the pleasures.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: By time.

2.en: Humanity is truly in loss.

3.ar: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
3.en: Except those who believe, do good, urge one another to truth, and urge one another to patience.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Woe to every backbiter and slanderer.

2.en: Who amasses wealth and counts it over and over.

3.ar: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ
3.en: He thinks his wealth will make him immortal.

4.ar: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنْبَذَنَّ فِي الْحُطَمَةِ
4.en: No! He will be hurled into the Crusher.

5.ar: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحُطَمَةُ
5.en: What will make you realize what the Crusher is?

6.ar: نَارُ اللَّهِ الْمُوقَدَةُ
6.en: It is the Fire of God, ever blazing.

7.ar: الَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى الْأَفْئِدَةِ
7.en: Which rises over the hearts.

8.ar: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِمْ مُؤْصَدَةٌ
8.en: It will close in on them.

9.ar: فِي عَمَدٍ مُمَدَّدَةٍ
9.en: In towering columns.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
1.en: Have you not seen what your Lord did to the people of the elephant?

2.en: Did He not turn their scheme into ruin?

3.ar: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
3.en: He sent against them birds in flocks.

4.ar: تَرْمِيهِمْ بِحِجَارَةٍ مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ
4.en: Pelting them with stones of baked clay.

5.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَأْكُولٍ
5.en: He made them like devoured husks.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: For the security of Quraysh.

2.en: Their security in the winter and summer caravans.

3.ar: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَٰذَا الْبَيْتِ
3.en: Let them worship the Lord of this House.

4.ar: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ
4.en: Who fed them against hunger and secured them against fear.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Have you seen the one who denies the Judgment?

2.en: That is the one who shoves aside the orphan.

3.ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
3.en: He does not urge the feeding of the poor.

4.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُصَلِّينَ
4.en: So woe to those who pray.

5.ar: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
5.en: Those who are heedless of their prayer.

6.ar: الَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَاءُونَ
6.en: Those who only show off.

7.ar: وَيَمْنَعُونَ الْمَاعُونَ
7.en: They withhold even small kindnesses.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: We have given you abundance.

2.en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice.

3.ar: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ
3.en: Your enemy is the one cut off.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Say, "O you who disbelieve."

2.en: I do not worship what you worship.

3.ar: وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ
3.en: Nor do you worship what I worship.

4.ar: وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَا عَبَدْتُمْ
4.en: Nor will I ever worship what you have worshiped.

5.ar: وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ
5.en: Nor will you ever worship what I worship.

6.ar: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ
6.en: To you your way, and to me mine.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: When the help of God comes and the victory.

2.ar: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
2.en: You see people entering God's religion in crowds.

3.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
3.en: So glorify your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness. He is ever accepting of repentance.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

2.ar: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ
2.en: His wealth will not benefit him, nor what he has earned.

3.ar: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ
3.en: He will burn in a Fire of blazing flames.

4.ar: وَامْرَأَتُهُ حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ
4.en: And his wife, the carrier of firewood.

5.ar: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِنْ مَسَدٍ
5.en: Around her neck is a rope of twisted fiber.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Say, "He is God, the One."

2.en: God, the Eternal Refuge.

3.ar: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
3.en: He neither begets nor was begotten.

4.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
4.en: And there is none comparable to Him.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak."

2.en: From the evil of what He created.

3.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
3.en: From the evil of darkness when it settles.

4.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
4.en: From the evil of those who blow on knots.

5.ar: وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
5.en: From the evil of an envier when he envies.

0.en: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

1.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind."

2.en: The King of mankind.

3.ar: إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
3.en: The God of mankind.

4.ar: مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
4.en: From the evil of the retreating whisperer.

5.ar: الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
5.en: Who whispers into the hearts of people.

6.ar: مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
6.en: From among jinn and people.
